request.style: English, Norwegian folk tune, kveding, an old female folk singer with a raw unpolished voice and ornamented melody, Hardanger fiddle with resonant drone strings, sparse and intimate, free rubato with a gentle springar pulse, 3/4, 70 BPM, sung in English
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
The LORD is my shepherd, I lack nothing
He lets me lie down in green pastures
He leads me beside still waters

[Verse]
He restores my soul
He guides me along right paths
For his name's sake

[Verse]
Even though I walk through the valley of the shadow of death
I fear no evil, for you are with me
Your rod and your staff, they comfort me

[Verse]
You set a table before me in the presence of my enemies
You anoint my head with oil, my cup overflows

[Verse]
Surely goodness and mercy will pursue me all the days of my life
And I will dwell in the house of the LORD for length of days
